## Why visit

A particularly persuasive rail-accessible choice for a west-Wirral beer day. The expanded shop premises combine a small bar, an additional lounge and a bottle shop, with a deliberately balanced cask selection. Recent local CAMRA recognition supports its standing without needing to rely on crowd-review scores. Pair it with Plasterers Arms to compare a modern micropub with a traditional neighbourhood pub, then continue to West Kirby if the day allows. Cider and take-home bottles add depth for experienced beer and cider drinkers.

## Beer

CAMRA records changing cask from regional brewers and a deliberate balance of styles. CAMRA identifies Purple Moose, RedWillow and Tatton as typical changing breweries, rather than fixed individual beers.
